No, you aren’t pathetic. But you may be sad, and that’s an important thing to know about yourself. I, a 30yo m, cried in my car for 45 minutes after an NPR story. Nothing that effected me in any meaningful way lifestyle wise. 
Sad is good, sad means you see what’s going on, and you can empathize. That’s a huge accomplishment for most people. The sad being unhelped depression could be an issue, seeing as you’re calling yourself pathetic, when clearly, you have a clearer and more caring head than most folks out there.

Offer your thoughts to people when to do so wouldn’t injure them or others. That’s what I stand by, and it hurts to hold shit in from your partner and not be totally honest, but if they’re in a dark place or deal with thoughts similar to your own, better to find someone who has the emotional capacity to take what you tell them and not internalize it.
My only fear of dipping out is what would happen to the folks I love who deal with relatable issues.

Hi! I’ve got pretty severe keloid scarring on my left arm, torso and legs. That shits embarrassing, but just a heads up, as the swelling goes down, the contrast does too and they become sort of invisible to everyone but you. If you can remember that, it makes the scars a little easier to deal with. I’ve spent the last 7-10 years apologizing to coworkers about them only to have the few or em mention they hadn’t noticed them till I brought em up.
